```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions straight from the checkout with pkgload; the
# repo is never installed (decision 0042). The site build sets CFB2NFL_ROOT,
# a local render finds the checkout from the working directory.
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
```

The processing pipeline is a [`targets`](https://books.ropensci.org/targets/)
graph (decision 0004) — the single source of truth for how raw data becomes
features, models, and results. The map below is **generated from the graph**, so
it can't drift from what the code actually does.

## Stages

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  ingest[ingest\nCFBD + nflverse] --> clean[clean\nstandardize + coerce keys]
  clean --> link[link\nplayer-season backbone + joins]
  link --> features[features\nlongitudinal change]
  features --> model[model\nexplain + predict]
  model --> report[report\nsite + viz]
  clean -.-> contracts[(data contracts)]
  clean -.-> audit[(audit log)]
  link -.-> audit
  features -.-> audit
```

## Live dependency graph

`tar_visnetwork()` renders the graph as an interactive `visNetwork` widget:
nodes carry the target name and runtime, clicking a node shows its output, and
the widget renders faster than a large static Mermaid diagram. Only targets are
drawn (`targets_only = TRUE`); the functions they call are left out so the data
flow stays readable.

```{r}
#| label: dag
tar_visnetwork(targets_only = TRUE, allow = NULL, label = "time")
```

## What remains

Targets that are outdated (need to run) — a live view of what's left to build or
refresh.

```{r}
#| label: outdated
outdated <- tryCatch(tar_outdated(), error = function(e) character(0))
if (length(outdated)) {
  tibble::tibble(target = outdated)
} else {
  cat("All targets are up to date.")
}
```

::: {.callout-important}
## Known gaps
`/roster` is now ingested, keyed on an authoritative `season` (stamped from the
queried year — the endpoint's own `year` is the eligibility class). But roster
**weight is static per player**, so the decision-0003 between-season
`weight_delta` is not derivable and was dropped; we keep the static roster
`weight`. The `model` and `report` stages are wired placeholders. Post-draft
**NFL outcomes** (nflverse) are now ingested and bridged to picks by draft slot,
but as *labels* — they stay off the model input path to avoid leakage (decision
0014).
:::
